content:
The leaf shows a grayish-green powdery/dusty coating across the surface, with small dark spots scattered throughout. The overall texture appears matte and covered with a whitish-gray fungal growth — consistent with powdery mildew. There is no die-back (branch/shoot death), no sooty black coating (sooty mould), and no anthracnose-typical sunken lesions or orange/brown necrotic spots.
